mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity_status_tasks (event_id, activity_id, target_status, source, execute_at, status, attempt, last_error, next_retry_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{activityId}, #{targetStatus}, #{source}, #{executeAt}, #{status}, #{attempt}, #{lastError}, #{nextRetryAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, event_id, activity_id, target_status, source, execute_at, status, attempt, last_error, next_retry_at, created_at, updated_at FROM activity_status_tasks WHERE event_id = #{eventId} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, event_id, activity_id, target_status, source, execute_at, status, attempt, last_error, next_retry_at, created_at, updated_at FROM activity_status_tasks WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= #{now}) UNION ALL SELECT id, event_id, activity_id, target_status, source, execute_at, status, attempt, last_error, next_retry_at, created_at, updated_at FROM activity_status_tasks WHERE status = 'SENT' AND updated_at <= #{sentBefore} ORDER BY updated_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE activity_status_tasks SET status = 'DONE', updated_at = #{updatedAt}, next_retry_at = NULL WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status != 'DONE'

UPDATE activity_status_tasks SET status = 'FAILED', attempt = #{attempt}, last_error = #{lastError}, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status != 'DONE'
UPDATE activity_status_tasks SET status = 'DEAD', attempt = #{attempt}, last_error = #{lastError}, next_retry_at = NULL, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status != 'DONE'
mapper.select: SELECT status, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM activity_status_tasks GROUP BY status
mapper.update: UPDATE activity_status_tasks SET status = 'PENDING', attempt = 0, last_error = NULL, next_retry_at = NULL, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE status = 'DEAD' ORDER BY updated_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
